name: Timi WHP, SK318, offshore Sarawak
description: Unmanned fixed wellhead platform about 200 km off Sarawak; installed in about 143 m water depth (Malaysia's deepest fixed platform to date, per PETRONAS); tied back to F23 hub by 80 km pipeline; solar and wind hybrid power; topside and substructure fabricated locally; two wells; operator Sarawak Shell 75%, PETRONAS Carigali 15%, Brunei Energy Exploration 10%; first gas 22 August 2023.
